title: Redelivery and Reschedule Tariff, Ridgeline Orders & Delivery
content:
| Fulfillment program | Redelivery charge | Notice before the delivery window for a free move (hours) | Free reschedules per order | Failed delivery attempts after which the order is cancelled | Store hold after a failed delivery (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Ship to Home | $0.00 | 0 | 0 | 0 (not applicable) | 0 |
| Ridgeline Buy Online Pick Up In Store | $0.00 | 0 | 0 | 0 (not applicable) | 0 |
| Ridgeline Ship to Store | $0.00 | 0 | 0 | 0 (not applicable) | 0 |
| Ridgeline Same-Day Delivery | $39.00 | 4 | 2 | 2 | 3 |
| Ridgeline Scheduled Truck Delivery | $79.00 | 24 | 3 | 2 | 7 |
| Ridgeline Appliance Delivery and Haul-Away | $29.00 | 24 | 3 | 2 | 7 |

Ridgeline Orders & Delivery charges for a second delivery, allows free moves of a booked delivery, cancels after repeated failed attempts and holds failed deliveries at the store on the per-program terms above.

**Redelivery charge.** The charge for a second delivery after the customer was absent or the site was inaccessible.

**Notice for a free move.** The number of hours before the delivery window by which a delivery may be moved free.

**Free reschedules per order.** The number of free reschedules allowed on one order.

**Failed attempts before cancellation.** The number of failed delivery attempts after which the order is cancelled and refunded less redelivery fees. A figure of 0 means the measure does not apply to the program.

**Store hold after a failed delivery.** The number of calendar days a failed-delivery order is held at the store for redelivery or pickup.

### Tariff readings (illustrative times and counts)

- A Ridgeline Scheduled Truck Delivery window starting at 08:00 on a Thursday: a request made at 07:30 on the Wednesday is 24 and a half hours before the window and meets the 24-hour notice; a request made at 14:00 on the Wednesday, 18 hours before, does not.
- A Ridgeline Same-Day Delivery window starting at 16:00: a request made at 11:30 is four and a half hours before and meets the 4-hour notice; one made at 13:00, three hours before, does not.
- A Ridgeline Appliance Delivery and Haul-Away order allows 3 free reschedules; a Ridgeline Same-Day Delivery order allows 2.
- Under Ridgeline Scheduled Truck Delivery, Ridgeline Same-Day Delivery and Ridgeline Appliance Delivery and Haul-Away the order is cancelled once failed delivery attempts reach 2.
- A Ridgeline Scheduled Truck Delivery order whose delivery failed is held at the store for 7 calendar days; a Ridgeline Same-Day Delivery order for 3.
